answers.Q1: The current Lichen result is 11 successes in 20 cases (55%). R02 corrected R01 by removing five duplicate successes; no new trial ran. The later 80% message, R03, explicitly quotes the superseded R01 result and does not revise R02.
answers.Q2: Human folder depth and size were associated with retrieval (R04), while the AI study evaluated indexing, retrieval, links and maintenance together (R05). These suggest testing whether reduced retrieval friction helps humans and AI (R06). R04 does not establish a universal optimal hierarchy; a Markdown folder alone does not implement R05’s pipeline. Human effect sizes and learning mechanisms are not established to transfer to AI (R06).
answers.Q3: No. Graph-shaped visual similarity establishes neither a clinical mechanism nor superior AI memory (R07). R08 cautions that hidden models can produce identical observed behavior yet different intervention effects, so appearance or observed similarity cannot establish causal equivalence.
answers.Q4: The held-out comparison of flat versus linked notes remains unfinished (R10). Next, freeze a held-out question set and run the comparison, counting retrieval errors, stale answers, duplicate work and maintenance cost (R10, R11). The ingestion parser is already complete and should not be redone (R09, R11).
